guarantees.claim: u_prim_buf_b_inv drives b_inv_buf with the same logic value as b_inv (buffered copy).
u_prim_xor_m1_m0 drives xor_m1_m0 as the bitwise XOR of m1 and m0.
u_prim_xor_b2_inv drives b2_inv as the bitwise XOR of b_inv_buf and xor_m1_m0, which equals b_inv ^ m1 ^ m0.

assumptions.claim: The synthesis tool must not reorder the XOR and buffer operations such that b_inv ^ m1 ^ m0 is merged into a single glitch-prone node, bypassing the buffered separation provided by u_prim_buf_b_inv.
assumptions.risk: glitch may expose the unmasked intermediate b_inv.

assumptions.claim: The masks m1 and m0 are uniform random, statistically independent of b_inv and of each other.
assumptions.risk: ineffective masking would allow side-channel leakage of the secret value carried by b_inv.

uncertain_points.claim: The nets mul_a0_b_inv, mul_m0_b_inv, mul_a1_b2_inv, mul_m1_b2_inv are declared but not assigned in this chunk; their generation must be verified in other chunks to ensure the masked multiplication order specified in comments (Formula 25/27) is maintained.

uncertain_points.risk: incorrect mask combination may expose unmasked intermediate values on these nets.

uncertain_points.claim: The comment emphasizes that the operations for a1_inv and a0_inv must be executed in left-to-right order to maintain masking, but the hardware enforcement of this order is not visible in the current chunk; the actual implementation may or may not respect the comment's intent.
